thesis: The podcast argues that high sales and marketing spending was not the primary cause of Wish's failure, as other companies with similar spending levels have succeeded. Instead, the analysis suggests the real issue was the ineffectiveness of Wish's advertising, noting that the podcast will rely on information available to investors before the company's decline to avoid hindsight bias.
